dataset_info.name: gameops-chatbot-payment-agent-db-grounded-30-v1
dataset_info.description: Payment agent examples grounded in actual payment/refund/item delivery/gacha rows.
paper_basis: Self-Instruct: generate diverse instruction/input/output examples, then filter invalid or near-duplicate samples.
Persona-based synthetic user simulation: vary user intent, urgency, expertise, and message style.
Synthetic user generated text evaluation: include short, noisy, incomplete, and typo-like user messages so evals are not overly clean.
dataset_info.generation_note: Synthetic user messages are generated from actual local DB records/documents. The expected evidence IDs point to the DB rows used to generate each example.
